notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.
The LED and 220 ohm resistor are marked optional in the parts list, but the circuit image and schematic use them, so they are built.
Circuit path: pin 13 -> orange wire -> 220 ohm resistor -> LED anode (long, bent leg) -> LED cathode -> black wire -> GND.
Breadboard holes are read from the image and named with the catalogue convention, where bank 'b' is rows f-j. The image draws rows f-j in the upper half, so that half is bank 'b'.

Column positions are estimated from the image. The resistor sits in row h, columns 3 and 6. The LED legs are in row i, anode in column 6 and cathode in column 8. The orange wire ends at 3b.g and the black wire at 8b.g.
The black wire goes to the GND header pin next to pin 13, which I took to be GND.1.
